events.title: 아스널 thrash 노리치 시티 5–0 at Highbury to effectively end the Canaries' title challenge. Maidstone United clinch the Conference title and are promoted to the Football League, giving them a clash next season with fellow Kent club 질링엄 , who are relegated to the Fourth Division on the same day.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 윔블던 1–0 in a league game at Old Trafford which is watched by 23,368, the club's lowest home crowd in the league since August 1971.

리버풀 play their first match since the Hillsborough tragedy, a 0–0 draw with 에버턴. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are relegated from the First Division after losing 2–1 to 웨스트햄 유나이티드, whose victory keeps their own slim survival hopes alive.
달링턴 are relegated from the Football League after 68 years when they lose 5–1 to 스컨소프 유나이티드 at Glanford Park .
Three weeks after the Hillsborough disaster, 리버풀's FA Cup semi-final clash with 노팅엄 포리스트 is replayed at Old Trafford. 리버풀 win 3–1 to keep their dream of a second double alive.
England striker 게리 리네커 collects a European Cup Winners' Cup medal as 바르셀로나 beat 삼프도리아 2–0 in the final.

미들즈브러 join 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in being relegated from the First Division after they lose a relegation showdown 1–0 away to 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 루턴 타운 beat 노리치 시티 1–0. The result ensures Wednesday's survival, and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 must now win their last two games to stay up at the expense of 애스턴 빌라. At the top, 아스널 suffer a 2–1 defeat at home to 더비 카운티, while 리버풀 beat 윔블던 2–1 to move within two points of the Gunners with a game in hand.
리버풀 move to the top of the First Division for the first time this season after beating 퀸스 파크 레인저스 2–0.
아스널 draw 2–2 with 윔블던 in their last home League game of the season. They are level on points with 리버풀 having played one game more.
리버풀 lift the FA Cup with a 3–2 win over 에버턴 after extra time. 이언 러시 scores twice for 리버풀 while John Aldridge scores the other goal, and Stuart McCall scores twice for 에버턴.
리버풀 wins the FA Cup , beating 에버턴 3–2 AET, thanks to two goals from 이언 러시 .

웨스트햄 유나이티드 are relegated after eight successive seasons of First Division football as they lose 5–1 to 리버풀 at Anfield. The result moves 리버풀 three points clear of 아스널 at the top of the table with one game remaining.
A.C. AC 밀란 defeats Steaua București , 4–0, to win their third European Cup final.
아스널 beat 리버풀 F.C. 2–0 at Anfield to dramatically win the English Football League First Division , thanks to an injury time goal from 마이클 토머스 .

아스널 win the league title in the final moments of the season thanks to a late goal from 마이클 토머스 against 리버풀 which gives them a 2–0 away win . First Division top scorer Alan Smith had put 아스널 ahead earlier in the second half. Their triumph gives them their first league championship trophy for 18 years, having scored more goals than their rivals, their points tallies and goal differences being identical. Former 리즈 유나이티드 and England manager 돈 레비 dies of motor neuron disease at the age of 61.
볼턴 원더러스 claim their first major trophy since the 1958 FA Cup by beating 토키 유나이티드 4–1 in the Associate Members' Cup final.
Copa Libertadores is won by Atlético 나시오날 after defeating Olimpia Asunción 5–4 on penalties after a final aggregate score of 2–2.
